verdict.rationale: Deel exposes webhooks for event-driven integrations and an MCP server whose tools (createTimeOffRequest, listOfContracts, etc.) can be invoked by AI agents, giving the building blocks for automation, but there is no evidence of a native scheduler or workflow engine that runs autonomously in the background without an external agent/orchestrator triggering it. missing for 10: evidence of built-in autonomous scheduling/triggers, evidence of persistent background automation runs, independent confirmation of real-world autonomous use.
